intent: Write a Facebook ad campaign: 3 ad variants, audience suggestions, and a short landing page blurb for a dental clinic.

spec.goal: Get a Facebook ad campaign for a dental clinic, made up of ad copy, audience suggestions and a landing page blurb.
spec.deliverable: A written campaign document containing 3 Facebook ad variants, audience suggestions, and a short landing page blurb for a dental clinic.
constraints: The campaign is for a dental clinic
The landing page blurb must be short
Audience suggestions are included as part of the campaign
Written deliverable only; no images, tools or integrations beyond what the request mentions
done_criteria: The document contains exactly 3 distinct Facebook ad variants
The document includes audience suggestions for targeting the ads
The document includes a short landing page blurb
All content is written for a dental clinic
spec.summary: You want a Facebook ad campaign for a dental clinic, with 3 ad variants, audience suggestions and a short landing page blurb.
